title: Bug A — Autodetect Maps Scientists to Wrong Domain
description: On the main branch, Dilay's autodetect maps "List 10 scientists" to the astronomy domain. Results include Pokémon scientists, LGBT people in science, and power engineering scientists — no real scientist names returned. Found 2026-04-22.

title: Bug B — Incorrect Entity IDs in Wikidata Sports Config
description: Incorrect entity IDs mapped in configs/*.yaml files for the Wikidata sports domain, causing wrong results for sport-related queries. Found 2026-04-22.

title: Bug C — Use This Button Does Nothing When Search Bar Has Existing Text
description: When the search bar already contains text, clicking the Use This button on an example card has no effect. Expected behaviour: the button should replace whatever is in the search bar with the example query. Found 2026-04-22.

title: Bug D — Piano Musician Queries Return Actors/Directors
description: List 10 piano musicians returns no meaningful results. List 10 pianists returns a list of actors and directors instead of pianists. The instrument/occupation property path used in the generated SPARQL does not correctly target pianists. Fix needed: add a schema hint or few-shot example demonstrating the correct Wikidata property path for musicians by instrument (e.g. wdt:P1303 wd:Q5994 for piano combined with wdt:P31 wd:Q5). Found 2026-04-22.

title: Bug E — Domain Resets to Scientists After Selecting Example Question
description: When a domain is manually selected from the dropdown and the user clicks one of the example questions, the question is correctly copied into the search box, but the UI then switches back to the scientists/default domain. Root cause: writing nl_input via on_click callback caused Streamlit to reset other widget keys including selected_domain. Fix: pending pattern — _use_example stores question and domain in _pending_nl_input/_pending_domain applied at script top before widgets instantiate. Fixed 2026-04-30.

title: Bug F — SPARQL-to-NL Explanation Is Unclear
description: The natural language explanation generated in the SPARQL→NL tab does not clearly summarise what the SPARQL query does. The output is difficult to understand and does not read as a plain-English description of the query intent. Fix needed: review and improve the summarisation prompt in the SPARQL→NL pipeline. Found 2026-04-29.

title: Bug G — Example Questions Do Not Return Results for All Domains
description: The example question cards shown for some domains do not return any results when executed. It has not been verified that every domain's example questions produce valid non-empty answers. Fix needed: run each example question across all domains and confirm they return expected results. Replace or fix any example that returns zero results. Found 2026-04-29.

title: Bug — Exclusion / Negation Only Works with Exact Entity ID
description: Queries like "List scientists who are not physicists" or "Diseases excluding cancer" either return wrong results or fail silently, unless the user provides the exact Wikidata ID. Root cause: generated SPARQL uses FILTER(?x != "cancer") string comparison instead of FILTER(?x != wd:Q12078). String matching against URIs always fails so the filter has no effect. Fix needed: inject an entity-linking step before SPARQL generation to resolve entity names in FILTER/negation clauses to canonical URIs, or add a schema_hint example demonstrating the correct pattern.

title: Bug — Olympic Gold Medalists in Athletics Returns Zero Results
description: Query "List Olympic gold medalists in athletics" returns 0 results. Likely cause: Wikidata medal data uses wdt:P166 (award received) + wd:Q319921 (Olympic gold medal) but the generated query probably uses DBpedia-style predicates that do not match the loaded dataset. Not fixed even though sport data is fixed — needs more testing.

title: Bug 1 — Fictional Entity in Results (Spider-Man)
description: The model returned Spider-Man as a scientist in a list of real scientists. Wikidata entity: http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q79037. Root cause: the SPARQL query does not filter by rdf:type dbo:Scientist or equivalent — fictional characters with scientist-adjacent properties slip through. Fix needed: add type constraints to the generated query (e.g. wdt:P31 wd:Q5 to restrict to humans, or filter against known fictional entity classes). Found 2026-04-22.

title: Bug 2 — Intermittent No-Result on Valid Queries
description: Who came up with unified field theory? returned no results on the first run but succeeded on a rerun with the same query. Suspected cause: non-deterministic LLM output generating a slightly different broken SPARQL on the first attempt, or a transient Wikidata endpoint timeout. Fix needed: add retry logic (1–2 retries) when the query returns 0 results; optionally surface the raw SPARQL so the user can inspect it. Found 2026-04-22.

title: Bug 3 — Model Switching Bug
description: Sidebar does not let the user change the model — it defaults to the first model in the list and does not update when a different model is selected. Behaviour after switching models needs to be fully documented. Found 2026-04-22.

title: Bug 4/5 — Hallucination in Summaries (Fixed)
description: The summarizer was adding invented names/IDs/dates from training memory. Fix: rewrote the summarizer prompt in src/answer_summarizer.py to strictly ground the LLM to the returned rows — framed the data block as the ONLY facts usable, added explicit rules against inventing or inferring values, and filtered URI columns before sending to the LLM.

title: Bug 7 — Domain Selector Grouped and Moved to NL→SPARQL Tab (Fixed)
description: Domain selector was in the sidebar and caused confusion. Fix: moved it into the NL→SPARQL tab next to the translate button, grouped under Wikidata and DBpedia section headers, with an on_change callback that snaps separator selections to the first valid domain. Auto option removed.

title: Bug 8 — Domain Tag on SPARQL→NL Cards (Fixed)
description: Removed the domain pill from the SPARQL→NL example cards. The NL→SPARQL cards keep their domain pill; SPARQL→NL cards do not need it as the query already describes the domain.

title: Bug 9 — Duplicate Rows in Results (Fixed)
description: Multi-valued properties in Wikidata/DBpedia caused Cartesian-product-style row duplication. Fix: added automatic DISTINCT injection inside clean_sparql() in src/sparql_executor.py — rewrites SELECT to SELECT DISTINCT when the query does not already use DISTINCT and does not contain aggregation functions or GROUP BY.

title: Bug 10 — Sports Domain Returns Wrong Athletes (Fixed)
description: Tennis player queries returned basketball players; soccer player queries returned no results. Root cause: incorrect entity IDs in configs/wikidata_sports.yaml. Fix: corrected entity IDs — wd:Q847 for tennis, wd:Q5372 for basketball, wd:Q2736 for association football, wd:Q937857 for football player — and rewrote few-shot examples using wdt:P641 for sport and wdt:P106 for occupation.

title: Bug — Knowledge Graph Rendering Inaccurate (Fixed)
description: Raw results were valid but the graph was not accurate — single-column list queries caused PyVIS to draw each row as a separate node with meaningless connections, and URIs and labels appeared as duplicate nodes. Fix: introduced two rendering modes — Mode 1 relational graph for 2+ URI columns, Mode 2 star graph for single URI column placing a central concept node and connecting each result to it.

title: Bug — Results Table Shown After Summary (Fixed)
description: The results table was only shown after the LLM summary finished generating. Fix: results table now appears as soon as the query returns, before the LLM summarizes.

title: Bug — SPARQL→NL Quick Examples Only Showed Current Domain (Fixed)
description: Example cards in the SPARQL→NL tab previously only showed examples from the currently selected domain. Fix: cards now pull one example from each domain config so you get a variety across Wikidata and DBpedia, with a domain tag on each card.

title: Bug — Sidebar Only Showed One Endpoint (Fixed)
description: Sidebar was only showing the endpoint for the currently selected domain. Fix: now lists both Wikidata and DBpedia endpoints with the active one bold and the inactive one dimmed.

title: Bug — No Readable Output for Zero Results (Fixed)
description: Zero-result queries showed a raw technical message. Fix: replaced with a friendly explanation and an optional expander showing the generated SPARQL for power users. Implemented by Jumainah on 2026-04-22.
